description: Pacific Power Distribution Generation Readiness is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The map viewer is a high-level display of PacifiCorp’s distribution system to facilitate a variety of perspectives and reflects information as of Fall 2021. One view supports a generalized assessment of installed distributed generation resources, such as qualified facilities, solar, battery or other technologies. Coverage: the United States. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Electricity, Renewables. Its keywords are electricity generation, generating units, distribution system. The portal shows 2024-05-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
